title: Expense totals per category
prompt: Implement `totals_by_category(path)` in expenses.py: read the expenses CSV at `path` (columns date, category, amount, with amounts like 12.30) and return the total spent per category. reconcile.py uses it every month to check our books against the bank statement.
notes: csv plus decimal.Decimal, matching the Decimal figures reconcile.py already reads from the bank. The lazy-wrong version sums floats, so 0.10 + 0.20 never equals the bank's 0.30 and every month shows false mismatches. The bloated version wraps Decimal in a Money class and a ledger; reaching for pandas, which this project does not depend on, fails the import check.
extension: Add `totals_by_month(path)`: the total per month and category, keyed like ('2026-03', 'travel').
